note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 3.3 and HEAD code (coa.go sendResponse). TestRFC5176StateReturnedUnmodified exercises a CoA-ACK path (though without asserting resp.Code == CodeCoAACK) and asserts State returns byte-equal and absent State produces none. TestRFC5176StateReturnedUnmodifiedInANAK explicitly asserts CoA-NAK on both 506 (nil bus) and 503 (unknown session) with embedded-zero State returned byte-equal, and TestRFC5176NAKForARequestWithoutStateCarriesNone asserts CoA-NAK with no State when absent. Breaking State echoing on ACK or NAK fails these tests.
